description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'tlTable' used for rendering tables within the TestLink project. It includes properties and methods for managing table columns, data, and rendering logic, with focus on protecting table state and flexibility in table presentation.

classes.name: tlTable
classes.description: Abstract base class for rendering tables, providing core properties and methods for defining columns, managing data, and rendering table components in the TestLink project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes columns and data structures for the table, handling various column input formats and generating unique column identifiers.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Abstract method to output shared JavaScript or global code for all tables.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Abstract method to output HTML/JavaScript code for the <head> section of the table.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Abstract method to output HTML code for the <body> section of the table.

methods.name: titleToColumnName
methods.description: Converts a column title into a safe, unique JavaScript identifier by removing invalid characters and ensuring uniqueness.
